# Impressiva Printing

> Custom print studio at 2200 Warehouse District, Pasadena. Business cards,
> vinyl banners, apparel, stickers and signage, produced on offset, digital,
> DTF, screen and wide-format equipment.

Every job is quoted on request, proofed digitally before it reaches the press,
and hand-checked against a G7-calibrated colour standard. Standard turnaround
is three to five working days; rush work goes out the same day. Collection is
at the studio, by local courier, or shipped nationwide.

- Phone: (555) 018-7746
- Email: hello@impressivaprinting.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday 8am to 6pm, Saturday 10am to 3pm

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.impressivaprinting.com/): studio overview, product
  categories, recent work and how an order moves.
- [Products](https://www.impressivaprinting.com/products): the full catalogue
  with stocks, finishes and shop codes for each service.
- [Work](https://www.impressivaprinting.com/work): recent apparel and custom
  print projects, filterable by category.
- [About](https://www.impressivaprinting.com/about): how the studio was built,
  its production standards and the equipment on the floor.
- [Contact](https://www.impressivaprinting.com/contact): quote requests, studio
  address, phone number and opening hours.
- [Privacy](https://www.impressivaprinting.com/privacy): what the shop stores,
  why, and for how long.
- [Terms](https://www.impressivaprinting.com/terms): quoting, proofing, colour,
  turnaround, payment and reprint terms.

- /portal, /admin and /account are account areas behind a sign-in.
